title: BCCI Scraps A+ Grade in Central Contracts Restructure
summary: BCCI moves from 4-tier to 3-tier central contract system (A, B, C), discontinuing the ₹7 Cr/year A+ bracket.

blocks.title: 📰 8. 📅 IMPORTANT DAYS & PERSONS IN NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 BCCI Scraps A+ Grade in Central Contracts Restructure. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: BCCI restructured player contracts into a **3-tier system (A, B, C)**. Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma moved to Grade B; new Grade A features **Shubman Gill, Jasprit Bumrah, and Ravindra Jadeja**.
